crons.comment: Backstop only, and a weak one. A queued run is nudged awake immediately by the action that created it (lib/jobs/trigger.ts); this collects what that nudge missed — a run whose worker died, or one queued while a deploy was in flight. Hobby REFUSES to deploy any expression that would fire more than once a day, so this is daily, and one tick claims one run and does one chunk. It is not the recovery path: Execute on the Background jobs page is. 02:00 UTC is ~07:30 Colombo, give or take the hour Hobby is allowed to drift, so anything stuck overnight is picked up as the factory day starts.

ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "blm-cloud-release" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
